programs.title: Genghis Khan: the Secret History of the Mongols
programs.sub_title: Temujin: The boy who became khan
programs.desc:
A profile of a man who went down in history as a brilliant military strategist.The six-episode series will present little-known facts from the life of the fearless leader.The authors will show how, after a difficult childhood and captivity, he managed to gain power, unite the quarreling tribes, build an invincible army and subjugate all those who opposed him, including his former allies.Impressive conquests will be discussed, including:expansion into the West, campaigns against the neighboring Tangut people and the Chinese Jin Empire.The troops he commanded were known for the mobility of their cavalry, carrying out rapid attacks and retreats, and applying psychological pressure on their opponents.They used innovative techniques during sieges of even well-fortified cities.Genghis Khan became one of the most important figures in history, expanding his empire to unprecedented sizes.It stretched from the Pacific to the Caspian and Black Seas.The creators of the series are based on a new translation of the anonymous chronicle "The Secret History of the Mongols", which is the oldest known monument of writing of the steppe peoples of Central Asia
A fascinating history lesson that combines a story about the past with spectacular stagings like a blockbuster.The six-episode documentary series presents little-known facts from the life of the legendary leader, focusing on his subsequent conquests and centuries-old legacy.The authors based their work on a new translation of the anonymous chronicle "The Secret History of the Mongols", which is the oldest known written monument of the steppe peoples of Central Asia.The experts' statements are the background of a historical thriller in which the realities of the 12th and 13th centuries have been carefully recreated.Thanks to this, the distant past becomes vivid and exciting.A boy from the steppes The starting point of the story about the life of the founder of the Mongol Empire are the turbulent years of his youth.Temujin, later known as Genghis Khan, experienced the decline of his family, poverty and a life of insecurity.He witnessed the tribes fighting.Viewers will see how this survival school influenced his ambitions and character development.As a young warrior, Genghis Khan formed alliances to save his abducted wife, Börte.Thanks to the marriage, he gained the support of the Kereite chief.He consistently made decisions that allowed him to create the largest land empire in history.
